_note: C-181 barn: buying its blueprint, building, feeding, milk on the ground. Each case runs through server/src/parcels/farm.ts (server/test/parcels/farm.test.ts) and modules/dynamic_farm/parcel_farm.gd (tests/dynamic_farm/test_barn.gd); both must give `expect`. C-202: the barn is SEN-C-179's 11×6 less its rear-left 2×2 (`cutouts`, kept on the placed building); those cells are free for other buildings, tilling and crops. C-209: a barn saved without cutouts (C-192's 8×6) is taken down before the commands: its blueprint, the rules' materials and its drops (laid or not, as their product) go into the bag. Generated by the server rules, with the owner's numbers (SEN-Q-282: 600 coins from farm level 2, 2 on the ground).
